description: LUT transformer (exp427-style) on nanochat data. E=64 everywhere, sum-mode pos_embs, out_canon (leak-fixed) in LUTBlock, BitPermutationLUT for q/k/v/out_proj. MLP unembedder LN(384) + Linear(384, 1536) + ReLU + Linear(1536, 32768) — same shape as exp427 except final fan-out is V=32768 instead of 257. seq_len=512 (vs exp427's 128). First LUT-based experiment using nanochat tokenizer + dataloader + BPB eval.
